subject: SDK migration playbook & API-gating schedule for Nexa Labs integration
messages:
From: Sara Lim <sara.lim@nexalabs.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 25 Jul 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Heads up — upcoming API changes impacting Nexa SDK (need migration guidance)

Hi Karthik,

Quick note from our engineering lead — Nexa's cloud SDK (used by ~30 customers) depends on a few Redwood endpoints that are slated for change in your next API cycle. We saw a note in the partner slack but need concrete migration guidance and schedules before we can ship updates to our customers.

Specific asks:
- Can you share the proposed breaking changes and an estimated removal date for deprecated endpoints?
- We need a migration checklist, compatibility matrix, and a sandbox we can run integration tests against.
- Ideally we get at least a 60–90 day overlap between v-old and v-new endpoints so we can roll customers gradually.

We'd like to avoid a big forced upgrade window — please flag any feature that will require client-side changes (auth, routing, streaming semantics, response format).

Cc'ing Vanessa because she previously coordinated integration tests with partners.

Thanks — can we get something by Tue (27th)?

Best,
Sara
Sara Lim
Head of Integrations, Nexa Labs
(sara.lim@nexalabs.ai)

Attachment: none (Nexa will attach SDK usage logs in follow-up)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lim <sara.lim@nexalabs.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 27 Jul 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Heads up — upcoming API changes impacting Nexa SDK (need migration guidance)

Hi Sara — thanks for the heads up and the tight timeline. We've drafted a partner-focused migration playbook that answers the items you listed and proposes gating to limit customer disruption. Summary below; attached are the migration checklist and compatibility matrix.

High-level plan (summary):
- Scope: changes affect the /v2/stream and /v2/embed routes (payload schema and streaming framing). No auth scheme changes.
- Overlap window: we will support both /v2/ and /v3/ endpoints concurrently for 90 days after v3 GA. Deprecation notices will go out 45 and 15 days before final removal.
- Migration checklist (attached): local compatibility tests, KV cache behavior check, response-schema validation, and streaming fallback tests.
- Canary gating: partners can opt into a canary that proxies ~5–10% of production traffic to v3 for validation. We'll provide logs and tokenized cost estimates during the canary.
- Sandbox: dedicated Nexa sandbox with mocked throughput limits and a copy of the compat-matrix for automated test runs. See sandbox access link in the attachments.

Action items for Nexa (proposed):
1) Run the attached compat-matrix against your CI and flag failures by Aug 10.
2) Sign up for the canary window (we'll open slots for Aug 17–21).
3) Confirm required SLAs for rollback behavior so we can configure auto-fallback.

I've looped Marissa to track any contract/credit asks and Vanessa to coordinate the technical sandbox provisioning. If that timeline is tight for you, tell us the earliest feasible date and we'll adapt.

Attachments: redwood-migration-checklist.xlsx, compat-matrix.csv

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Phone: +1 415 555 0187

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lim <sara.lim@nexalabs.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SDK migration playbook & API-gating schedule for Nexa Labs integration

Hi all — quick technical clarifications from the product/infra side so Nexa can scope the SDK changes:

Notes on the changes we plan to ship in v3:
- Streaming framing: we are standardizing chunk envelopes (edge -> kernel) which changes how partial tokens are emitted. This affects SDK client buffering and on_data callbacks.
- Response schema: embeddings will return an explicit metadata block (embedding_version) — minor shape change but _not_ content change.
- Performance: v3 enables continuous batching optimizations; latency distribution will improve but cold-cache tail may differ.

Compatibility guidance:
- For most clients, adding a simple response-shape adapter (map old fields -> new fields) will be sufficient.
- We will provide an adapter shim in the SDK (—experimental) to ease transition; recommended for partners that cannot update clients quickly.

Sandbox access: we will provision a Nexa sandbox (credentials attached in sandbox-access.txt) and create a short-run cheat-sheet for canary verification (latency, token accounting, streaming-order tests).

Versioning and release gating:
- New SDK artifact will be released as redwood-sdk-js v4.0.0 (major bump).
- We will tag a compatibility label: v4+compat means the shim is available; v4-strict means endpoint semantics are v3-only.

I'll coordinate with infra to open canary slots Aug 17–21. Karthik — please confirm the preferred rollback SLO and whether Nexa needs cross-region canary (we can enable us/eu for you).

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Platform Partnerships | Redwood Inference

From: Sara Lim <sara.lim@nexalabs.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Devin Zhao <devin.zhao@nexalabs.ai>
Date: Sat, 1 Aug 2026 14:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SDK migration playbook & API-gating schedule for Nexa Labs integration

Thanks — this is helpful and the attachments look like what we need. A couple quick confirmations from our side:

- Aug 17–21 canary week works for Nexa; we'll reserve engineering time to run the compatibility matrix.
- We accept the 90-day overlap but would like the 45/15 day deprecation notices in writing so we can communicate to customers.
- Please include the experimental shim in the sandbox so we can validate whether we can avoid customer SDK churn.

Can we get a short mutual action plan (MAP) document with exact dates and owners? If you can send that by EOD Monday (3rd) we'll align internal PMs.

Forwarding our internal ask log below for context.
